text:
I fixed seven bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so none of this is verified. I checked each fix against the tests by reading them.

- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. It was left as a string.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books` was missing the `Emma` book, so I added it.
- `fees.py`: `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE` instead of adding them.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` was returning `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- `search.py`: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
